newsitem.title: NORWAY: BNbank asks shareholders to accept DnB.
newsitem.headline: BNbank asks shareholders to accept DnB.

text.p: Niche mortgage lender BNbank said on Friday its board had recommended to shareholders who have not responded to a takeover offer by Den norske Bank (DnB) to accept the bid as soon as possible.
In a statement on the Oslo bourse, Trondheim-based BNbank said DnB had received 82 percent acceptance from shareholders to its bid, which expires at 1500 GMT on Thursday.
DnB, Norway's largest bank, on Tuesday raised its offer by five crowns to 203.50 crowns per share excluding dividend.
The bank launched its bid in March in competition with a rival bid for BNbank by Fokus Bank. Fokus, Norway's fourth biggest bank, has a share exchange offer valuing BNbank at 2.06 billion crowns.
BNbank's statement said its board had decided not to begin negotiations with Fokus Bank.
